summary.reception: It was nominated for five awards at the 97th Academy Awards (including Best Picture), winning two, and received numerous accolades mostly for technical achievement. The American Film Institute cited it as one of the top ten films of 2024, with the organization's write up saying the film "unleashes all the powers of the art form to fulfill the prophecy of its predecessor." Dune: Part Two drew near unanimous praise for its fictional world, which critics recognized for its craftsmanship and sense of immersion. A recurring subject in the reviews was the actors' performances.
summary.story: Dune: Part Two is a 2024 American epic space opera film directed by Denis Villeneuve, from a screenplay he wrote with Jon Spaihts. It is a sequel to Dune (2021) in a two-part adaptation of Frank Herbert's 1965 science fiction novel, and the second of a trilogy of films developed by Legendary Pictures. Timothée Chalamet leads a twelve-actor ensemble cast as Paul Atreides, an exiled monarch who allies with the Fremen peoples to overthrow the House Harkonnen as part of a quest to become a messianic figure. A sequel based on Herbert's novel Dune Messiah (1969), Dune: Part Three, is scheduled for release on December 18, 2026. Dune: Part Two was well received in the media. The tone was generally positive, the ensemble described as "exceptional" and "impressive".
